messages.content: Explain quantum entanglement but you have to explain it in exactly 3 sentences and make sure a 10-year-old could understand it.

Imagine you have two magical coins that are best friends — when you flip them, even if one is on Earth and the other is on the moon, they always land the same way, like they're secretly talking to each other instantly! In real life, scientists can link tiny particles together so that measuring one particle immediately tells you about the other, no matter how far apart they are. This spooky connection is called quantum entanglement, and it's one of the weirdest and coolest things in the universe!
